item.title: Mountain Home Man Killed in Christmas Day Crash
item.description: A 75-year-old Mountain Home man was killed in an accident on Christmas day on Highway 201 near Pigeon Creek. According to the report from the Arkansas State Patrol the accident occurred when he crossed the centerline, went off the left side of the roadway, struck an embankment and overturned in a 2015 Jeep. item.title: Major Shift in Temperatures and Wind Gusts Have Made Their Way to the Ozarks
item.description: After multiple days in the 70’s winter is making an appearance in the Ozarks. Sunday reached the mid 70’s and the low by morning will be in the teens. The cold snap will last over the next few days so make sure to leave you faucets dripping to prevent frozen pipes. item.title: Baxter County Arrests a Man for Theft on Sunday
item.description: The Baxter County Sheriff’s Department arrested 26-year-old Kyle Brahm on Sunday afternoon. Brahm is being charged with a class B Felony of Theft of Property. He is being held on a bond of $20,000 at the Baxter County Jail. He has had 17 prior bookings with the Baxter County Sheriff’s Department.
